mapper.sql: f.ID, f.FEEDBACK_NO, f.TITLE, f.CONTENT, f.FEEDBACK_TYPE_ID, f.COMPLAINANT_ID, f.SOURCE, f.PRIORITY, f.STATUS, f.DEPT_ID, f.HANDLER_ID, f.SLA_DEADLINE, f.SLA_WARNING_TIME, f.IS_ANONYMOUS, f.CONTACT_PHONE, f.CONTACT_EMAIL, f.RATING, f.RATING_COMMENT, f.CREATE_BY, f.CREATE_TIME, f.UPDATE_BY, f.UPDATE_TIME, f.DEL_FLAG, f.REMARK
mapper.select: SELECT , c.ID AS C_ID, c.NAME AS C_NAME, c.ID_CARD AS C_ID_CARD, c.PHONE AS C_PHONE, c.EMAIL AS C_EMAIL, c.GENDER AS C_GENDER, c.AGE AS C_AGE, c.ADDRESS AS C_ADDRESS, c.OCCUPATION AS C_OCCUPATION, c.PATIENT_ID AS C_PATIENT_ID, ft.ID AS FT_ID, ft.TYPE_NAME AS FT_TYPE_NAME, ft.TYPE_CODE AS FT_TYPE_CODE, ft.SLA_DAYS AS FT_SLA_DAYS, ft.SLA_HOURS AS FT_SLA_HOURS, ft.DESCRIPTION AS FT_DESCRIPTION, d.ID AS D_ID, d.DEPT_NAME AS D_DEPT_NAME, d.DEPT_CODE AS D_DEPT_CODE, u.ID AS U_ID, u.USERNAME AS U_USERNAME, u.REAL_NAME AS U_REAL_NAME, u.PHONE AS U_PHONE FROM T_FEEDBACK f LEFT JOIN T_COMPLAINANT c ON f.COMPLAINANT_ID = c.ID AND c.DEL_FLAG = 0 LEFT JOIN T_FEEDBACK_TYPE ft ON f.FEEDBACK_TYPE_ID = ft.ID AND ft.DEL_FLAG = 0 LEFT JOIN SYS_DEPT d ON f.DEPT_ID = d.ID AND d.DEL_FLAG = 0 LEFT JOIN SYS_USER u ON f.HANDLER_ID = u.ID AND u.DEL_FLAG = 0 WHERE f.ID = #{id} AND f.DEL_FLAG = 0

SELECT , c.ID AS C_ID, c.NAME AS C_NAME, c.ID_CARD AS C_ID_CARD, c.PHONE AS C_PHONE, c.EMAIL AS C_EMAIL, c.GENDER AS C_GENDER, c.AGE AS C_AGE, c.ADDRESS AS C_ADDRESS, c.OCCUPATION AS C_OCCUPATION, c.PATIENT_ID AS C_PATIENT_ID, ft.ID AS FT_ID, ft.TYPE_NAME AS FT_TYPE_NAME, ft.TYPE_CODE AS FT_TYPE_CODE, ft.SLA_DAYS AS FT_SLA_DAYS, ft.SLA_HOURS AS FT_SLA_HOURS, ft.DESCRIPTION AS FT_DESCRIPTION, d.ID AS D_ID, d.DEPT_NAME AS D_DEPT_NAME, d.DEPT_CODE AS D_DEPT_CODE, u.ID AS U_ID, u.USERNAME AS U_USERNAME, u.REAL_NAME AS U_REAL_NAME, u.PHONE AS U_PHONE FROM T_FEEDBACK f LEFT JOIN T_COMPLAINANT c ON f.COMPLAINANT_ID = c.ID AND c.DEL_FLAG = 0 LEFT JOIN T_FEEDBACK_TYPE ft ON f.FEEDBACK_TYPE_ID = ft.ID AND ft.DEL_FLAG = 0 LEFT JOIN SYS_DEPT d ON f.DEPT_ID = d.ID AND d.DEL_FLAG = 0 LEFT JOIN SYS_USER u ON f.HANDLER_ID = u.ID AND u.DEL_FLAG = 0 WHERE f.FEEDBACK_NO = #{feedbackNo} AND f.DEL_FLAG = 0

SELECT , c.ID AS C_ID, c.NAME AS C_NAME, c.ID_CARD AS C_ID_CARD, c.PHONE AS C_PHONE, c.EMAIL AS C_EMAIL, c.GENDER AS C_GENDER, c.AGE AS C_AGE, c.ADDRESS AS C_ADDRESS, c.OCCUPATION AS C_OCCUPATION, c.PATIENT_ID AS C_PATIENT_ID, ft.ID AS FT_ID, ft.TYPE_NAME AS FT_TYPE_NAME, ft.TYPE_CODE AS FT_TYPE_CODE, ft.SLA_DAYS AS FT_SLA_DAYS, ft.SLA_HOURS AS FT_SLA_HOURS, ft.DESCRIPTION AS FT_DESCRIPTION, d.ID AS D_ID, d.DEPT_NAME AS D_DEPT_NAME, d.DEPT_CODE AS D_DEPT_CODE, u.ID AS U_ID, u.USERNAME AS U_USERNAME, u.REAL_NAME AS U_REAL_NAME, u.PHONE AS U_PHONE, hr.ID AS HR_ID, hr.FEEDBACK_ID AS HR_FEEDBACK_ID, hr.HANDLER_ID AS HR_HANDLER_ID, hr.ACTION AS HR_ACTION, hr.CONTENT AS HR_CONTENT, hr.ATTACHMENT_IDS AS HR_ATTACHMENT_IDS, hr.RESULT AS HR_RESULT, hr.IS_VISIBLE AS HR_IS_VISIBLE, hr.CREATE_TIME AS HR_CREATE_TIME, a.ID AS A_ID, a.BUSINESS_ID AS A_BUSINESS_ID, a.BUSINESS_TYPE AS A_BUSINESS_TYPE, a.FILE_NAME AS A_FILE_NAME, a.FILE_PATH AS A_FILE_PATH, a.FILE_SIZE AS A_FILE_SIZE, a.FILE_TYPE AS A_FILE_TYPE, a.CREATE_BY AS A_CREATE_BY, a.CREATE_TIME AS A_CREATE_TIME FROM T_FEEDBACK f LEFT JOIN T_COMPLAINANT c ON f.COMPLAINANT_ID = c.ID AND c.DEL_FLAG = 0 LEFT JOIN T_FEEDBACK_TYPE ft ON f.FEEDBACK_TYPE_ID = ft.ID AND ft.DEL_FLAG = 0 LEFT JOIN SYS_DEPT d ON f.DEPT_ID = d.ID AND d.DEL_FLAG = 0 LEFT JOIN SYS_USER u ON f.HANDLER_ID = u.ID AND u.DEL_FLAG = 0 LEFT JOIN T_HANDLE_RECORD hr ON f.ID = hr.FEEDBACK_ID LEFT JOIN T_ATTACHMENT a ON f.ID = a.BUSINESS_ID AND a.BUSINESS_TYPE = 'FEEDBACK' AND a.DEL_FLAG = 0 WHERE f.ID = #{id} AND f.DEL_FLAG = 0 ORDER BY hr.CREATE_TIME ASC

SELECT STATUS AS status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM T_FEEDBACK WHERE DEL_FLAG = 0
AND CREATE_TIME >= TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND CREATE_TIME <= TO_DATE(#{endDate} || ' 23:59:59', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
GROUP BY STATUS

SELECT ft.TYPE_NAME AS typeName, COUNT(*) AS count FROM T_FEEDBACK f LEFT JOIN T_FEEDBACK_TYPE ft ON f.FEEDBACK_TYPE_ID = ft.ID AND ft.DEL_FLAG = 0 WHERE f.DEL_FLAG = 0
AND f.CREATE_TIME >= TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND f.CREATE_TIME <= TO_DATE(#{endDate} || ' 23:59:59', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
GROUP BY ft.TYPE_NAME

SELECT SOURCE AS source, COUNT(*) AS count FROM T_FEEDBACK WHERE DEL_FLAG = 0
AND CREATE_TIME >= TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND CREATE_TIME <= TO_DATE(#{endDate} || ' 23:59:59', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
GROUP BY SOURCE
mapper.insert:
SELECT SEQ_T_FEEDBACK.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO T_FEEDBACK ( ID, FEEDBACK_NO, TITLE, CONTENT, FEEDBACK_TYPE_ID, COMPLAINANT_ID, SOURCE, PRIORITY, STATUS, DEPT_ID, HANDLER_ID, SLA_DEADLINE, SLA_WARNING_TIME, IS_ANONYMOUS, CONTACT_PHONE, CONTACT_EMAIL, RATING, RATING_COMMENT, CREATE_BY, CREATE_TIME, DEL_FLAG, REMARK ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{feedbackNo}, #{title}, #{content}, #{feedbackTypeId}, #{complainantId}, #{source}, #{priority}, #{status}, #{deptId}, #{handlerId}, #{slaDeadline}, #{slaWarningTime}, #{isAnonymous}, #{contactPhone}, #{contactEmail}, #{rating}, #{ratingComment}, #{createBy}, NVL(#{createTime}, SYSDATE), NVL(#{delFlag}, 0), #{remark} )
mapper.update: UPDATE T_FEEDBACK SET STATUS = #{status}, UPDATE_BY = #{updateBy}, UPDATE_TIME = SYSDATE WHERE ID = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT , c.ID AS C_ID, c.NAME AS C_NAME, c.ID_CARD AS C_ID_CARD, c.PHONE AS C_PHONE, c.EMAIL AS C_EMAIL, c.GENDER AS C_GENDER, c.AGE AS C_AGE, c.ADDRESS AS C_ADDRESS, c.OCCUPATION AS C_OCCUPATION, c.PATIENT_ID AS C_PATIENT_ID, ft.ID AS FT_ID, ft.TYPE_NAME AS FT_TYPE_NAME, ft.TYPE_CODE AS FT_TYPE_CODE, ft.SLA_DAYS AS FT_SLA_DAYS, ft.SLA_HOURS AS FT_SLA_HOURS, ft.DESCRIPTION AS FT_DESCRIPTION, d.ID AS D_ID, d.DEPT_NAME AS D_DEPT_NAME, d.DEPT_CODE AS D_DEPT_CODE, u.ID AS U_ID, u.USERNAME AS U_USERNAME, u.REAL_NAME AS U_REAL_NAME, u.PHONE AS U_PHONE FROM T_FEEDBACK f LEFT JOIN T_COMPLAINANT c ON f.COMPLAINANT_ID = c.ID AND c.DEL_FLAG = 0 LEFT JOIN T_FEEDBACK_TYPE ft ON f.FEEDBACK_TYPE_ID = ft.ID AND ft.DEL_FLAG = 0 LEFT JOIN SYS_DEPT d ON f.DEPT_ID = d.ID AND d.DEL_FLAG = 0 LEFT JOIN SYS_USER u ON f.HANDLER_ID = u.ID AND u.DEL_FLAG = 0 WHERE f.DEL_FLAG = 0 AND f.SLA_WARNING_TIME <= SYSDATE AND f.STATUS IN ('PENDING', 'ASSIGNED', 'PROCESSING') ORDER BY f.SLA_WARNING_TIME ASC
